title: The ALMA View of Positive Black Hole Feedback in the Dwarf Galaxy Henize 2─10
question: What are the properties, kinematics, and excitation conditions of the submillimeter continuum and molecular gas in the immediate vicinity of the central massive black hole in the dwarf starburst galaxy Henize 2–10, and how do they relate to positive BH feedback?

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image ALMA continuum and spectral line visibilities
recipe.method: Run scriptForPI.py, flag bad antennas, subtract continuum with uvcontsub (order 1), image cubes and continuum with tclean (hogbom, briggsbwtaper/perchanweightdensity for lines; MFS/mtmfs nterms=3 for continuum), and smooth cubes with imsmooth.
key_parameters: uvcontsub fit order = 1; tclean threshold = 2 sigma; velocity frame = BARY; continuum SPW channel width = 15.625 MHz; low-Band 3 nterms = 3; Band 3 split frequency = 110 GHz

recipe.goal: Align astrometry of ALMA images and cubes to the 2MASS frame
recipe.method: Match the local maximum of the BH in the 251 GHz ALMA continuum image to the BH center in the 2MASS-aligned 1.4 GHz LBA continuum image and apply the spatial shift to all ALMA products.
key_parameters: Delta RA = 0.0735" West, Delta DEC = 0.095" North
assumptions: 251 GHz local maximum corresponds to the 1.4 GHz LBA radio core of the BH

recipe.goal: Measure sub-mm continuum flux densities and fit the 1.4–340 GHz SED of the BH
recipe.method: Convolve all ALMA continuum images to 0.55" x 0.32" with imsmooth, perform elliptical aperture photometry on the BH, estimate RMS noise with AIPS RMSD, measure adjacent 340 GHz sources with PyBDSF, and fit 1.4–340 GHz SED models using R nls and confint2.
key_parameters: Convolved beam / aperture size = 0.55" x 0.32", PA = -64.0 deg; AIPS RMSD rejection > 3 sigma within 150 pixels
assumptions: 33 GHz VLA flux density excluded from fit due to weather decorrelation; free-free spectral index = -0.1, dust spectral index = 4 in tested multi-component models

recipe.goal: Generate moment maps and position-velocity diagrams of molecular gas
recipe.method: Create masks on non-PB-corrected cubes using 3D-Barolo (Duchamp algorithm) with primary S/N = 5 and secondary S/N = 3, multiply PB-corrected cubes by masks to get moment 0, 1, 2 maps, and extract PVDs along PA = 100 deg to measure velocity gradients.
key_parameters: 3D-Barolo primary S/N = 5, secondary S/N = 3; PVD PA = 100 deg, bin width = 0.3" (CO 3-2) and 0.45" (CO 1-0), velocity gradient range = -0.4" to 0.8" (CO 3-2) and -0.5" to 0.85" (CO 1-0) above 3 sigma

recipe.goal: Isolate molecular gas in the BH vicinity and derive its H2 mass
recipe.method: Generate restricted moment maps within 852.1–904.6 km s^-1, define the BH vicinity ellipse, measure mean velocities and CO luminosity L'_CO, and convert to M_H2 using a metallicity-dependent alpha_CO range.
key_parameters: Velocity range = 852.1–904.6 km s^-1; ellipse center = RA 08h36m15.108s, Dec -26d24m34.343s, size = 2.97" x 0.79" (128 pc x 34 pc), PA = 80.34 deg (or 83.34 deg in Table 3)
assumptions: alpha_CO = 0.6 to 4.3 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 based on central metallicity 12 + [O/H] approx 9.0 (Z = 0.044); d = 9 Mpc

recipe.goal: Compute spatially resolved CO (3-2)/(1-0) line ratio map R_31
recipe.method: Convolve CO (1-0) and CO (3-2) cubes to a common 0.45" x 0.30" beam using imsmooth and compute pixel-by-pixel ratio R_31 = (nu_32 / nu_10)^-2 (I_CO(3-2) / I_CO(1-0)).

recipe.goal: Estimate H2 column density, optical extinction A_V, dust mass, and gas-to-dust ratio in the western star-forming region
recipe.method: Measure CO (1-0) intensity between regions 5 and 6 to derive N(H2) and A_V (combining with VLA N(HI)), and measure 340 GHz continuum flux in region 6 to calculate dust mass and compare with H2 mass.
key_parameters: CO (3-2) channel map velocity range = 864.1–887.8 km s^-1; 3D-Barolo primary S/N = 5, secondary S/N = 3
assumptions: X_CO = (0.28–2) x 10^20 cm^-2 (K km s^-1)^-1; uniform HI distribution with N(HI) = (1.51 +/- 0.05) x 10^18 cm^-2; A_V = 4.81 x 10^-22 (N(HI) + 2N(H2)); kappa_340GHz = 1.3 cm^2 g^-1; T_d = 29 K; D = 9 Mpc

score_reason: All ALMA archival project codes, software versions (CASA 6.5.1), astrometric shifts, and analysis equations are clearly stated, and aperture/ellipse geometries for the BH and BH vicinity are well specified. However, Table 2 is missing from page 5 of the text, which removes the exact tclean robust parameters, cell sizes, velocity spacings, and line-free channel ranges needed for an exact reproduction from visibilities.
rediscovery_reason: All six ALMA datasets are public in the archive, the main claims rely on quantitative continuum photometry, SED fitting, CO luminosity/mass, and CO (3-2)/(1-0) line ratios in well-defined regions, and the overall workflow is well documented despite the missing Table 2.
